request.state: A complete one-command Can release must run without asking users to install language tools. Local inspection found a2.2MiB compiler, Node22+ host code tested on Node24, four Bun bundling calls (one consumes arbitrary saved generated views), a109MiB macOS worker engine, and a593KiB native helper. Generated output uses runtime-resolved modules, file-relative assets and WASM. Playwright is optional for ordinary preview but required by existing generation acceptance. There is no isolated-runtime validation under Bun yet. esbuild is already used for developer builds; adopting it for these four calls changes generated code and demands behavioral checks. Candidate work now: preserve current runtime algorithms and package only production files with private Node+Bun; swap Bun bundling for esbuild and test the altered paths; or substitute Bun for Node and test runtime/IPC compatibility. Assess immediate delivery of complete installation and size, with future optimization allowed.

approach.instructions: Select the next delivery approach that best serves completeness, small footprint and proportionate verification.

criteria.preserve: Package current execution engines and strictly needed production files, establishing actual complete size first.
criteria.esbuild: Adopt esbuild in place of Bun subprocesses and qualify all changed output routes.
criteria.bun_only: Remove private Node by qualifying the entire host under Bun.
